key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a robot-first phase deploying ~10,000 autonomous swarm robots on Mars before human arrival.
Controlled failure by robots becomes operational learning, reducing uncertainty for later human settlement.
Robot-first approach complements rather than replaces human settlement ambitions.
Emphasizes AI governance, human oversight, accountability and planetary protection.
Calls for compliance with international space law.
annotation.summary_en: Conceptual journal article proposing a robot-first Mars settlement framework in which about 10,000 autonomous swarm robots test infrastructure and failure recovery before humans arrive. It argues this complements human settlement and stresses AI governance, human oversight, accountability, planetary protection and compliance with international space law.
annotation.title_clean: Robot-First Mars Settlement: A Conceptual Framework for Technology Governance, Risk
